bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Podenco (type) owners tracking 12-14 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where parvovirus risk concentrates for this puppy.
Use the 4-row Podenco (type) schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP); 12 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (DA2PP / DHPP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for Podenco (type) handling: Spanish warren hound type label; individuals vary.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the Podenco (type) dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this Podenco (type) core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Podenco (type) boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the puppy and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Podenco (type) row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra DA2PP / DHPP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Podenco (type) item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Podenco (type) kennel reservation.

faqs.question: When does the Podenco (type) core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Podenco (type) misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Podenco (type) health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Podenco (type) adult health guide for breed predispositions such as allergies, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
